newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine mills plan to buy U.S. wheat, soybean.
newsitem.headline: Philippine mills plan to buy U.S. wheat, soybean.

text.p: Philippine mills sought tenders on Wednesday for a total 55,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 7,500 tonnes of soybean, traders said.
"We received price inquiries for 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat from a group of millers following the drop in Chicago prices for the fourth consecutive session last night," said one trader.

An executive at another flour mill said his company would conduct bidding on Wednesday for the supply of 7,500 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content and another 7,500 tonnes of western white wheat.
The firm also planned to buy 7,500 tonnes soybean, he said.
